purpose: Every standalone Towns & Towers savanna, tipi and trader-camp piece, both complete CTOV savanna villages with the savanna outpost, and the Dungeons & Taverns acacia tavern set, for selecting the Savanna Tent catalog. The T&T Nilotic houses stand in the last row for comparison; they are the Floodplain catalog.
worldNote: Placed in the trio test world east of the Nautical gallery, with the savanna biome filled through every row's sky so lightning cannot strike the tents.
selectionRule: Every standalone piece of the T&T savanna plateau village and camp, the wooded badlands tipi village and camp, the wandering trader camp and the savanna outpost tower; every standalone CTOV savanna and Native American savanna piece plus the savanna outpost, roads omitted and entities stripped, with other mods' blocks shown as neutral vanilla markers; every non-villager D&T acacia tavern module and the savanna well; the showcase's assembled ramshackled tower village; and the T&T Nilotic houses for comparison. Street, terminator and villager templates are omitted.
